title: Flight Delays
description: US domestic flight delays from BTS on-time performance data (faa.ontime).

list.name: catalog
list.label: Catalog
list.description: The Unity Catalog catalog holding the faa schema. scripts/grafana-provision.sh sets it from databricks.catalog.

list.name: airline
list.label: Airline
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT Reporting_Airline FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT Reporting_Airline FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime ORDER BY 1

list.name: origin
list.label: Origin airport
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT Origin FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT Origin FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime ORDER BY 1

list.name: min_flights
list.label: Min flights flown
list.description: Only city pairs and flight numbers with at least this many completed flights in the time range are ranked in the top-10 charts, so that a few cancellations on a rarely flown route don't top the list.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS flights FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})

panels.title: On-time arrivals
panels.description: Arrived less than 15 minutes late, as a share of flights that completed (DOT definition).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT try_divide(100 * count_if(ArrDel15 = 0), count_if(Cancelled = 0 AND Diverted = 0)) AS on_time
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})

panels.title: Avg arrival delay
panels.description: Mean arrival delay of completed flights; early arrivals count as negative.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(ArrDelay) AS delay FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})

panels.title: Avg delay if late
panels.description: Mean arrival delay of flights that arrived 15+ minutes late.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(if(ArrDel15 = 1, ArrDelay, NULL)) AS delay FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})

SELECT 100 * avg(Cancelled) AS cancelled FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})

SELECT 100 * avg(Diverted) AS diverted FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})

panels.title: Average delay by day
panels.description: Mean delay in minutes per day (local date of departure). Negative = early.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(FlightDate AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
       avg(DepDelay) AS `Departure delay`,
       avg(ArrDelay) AS `Arrival delay`
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Late and cancelled flights by day
panels.description: Share of each day's scheduled flights.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(FlightDate AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
       100 * count_if(DepDel15 = 1) / count(*) AS `Departed 15+ min late`,
       100 * count_if(ArrDel15 = 1) / count(*) AS `Arrived 15+ min late`,
       100 * avg(Cancelled) AS `Cancelled`
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Delay minutes by cause, per month
panels.description: Total delay minutes attributed to each cause (reported for flights arriving 15+ min late). Note most weather delay is booked under NAS, not 'Extreme weather'.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(trunc(FlightDate, 'MM') AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
       sum(CarrierDelay) AS Carrier,
       sum(LateAircraftDelay) AS `Late aircraft`,
       sum(NASDelay) AS `Air traffic system (NAS)`,
       sum(WeatherDelay) AS `Extreme weather`,
       sum(SecurityDelay) AS Security
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Airlines
panels.description: Reporting carriers by on-time arrival rate. Codes are BTS carrier codes (AA American, DL Delta, UA United, WN Southwest, B6 JetBlue, AS Alaska, NK Spirit, F9 Frontier, ...).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Reporting_Airline AS Airline,
       count(*) AS Flights,
       round(try_divide(100 * count_if(ArrDel15 = 0), count_if(Cancelled = 0 AND Diverted = 0)), 1) AS `On time %`,
       round(avg(ArrDelay), 1) AS `Avg arr delay`,
       round(100 * avg(Cancelled), 2) AS `Cancelled %`
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
GROUP BY Reporting_Airline ORDER BY `On time %` DESC

panels.title: Departure delay by scheduled hour
panels.description: By scheduled local departure hour. Delays build up through the day as late aircraft knock on.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lpad(CAST(CRSDepTime DIV 100 % 24 AS STRING), 2, '0') AS hour,
       round(avg(DepDelay), 1) AS `Avg departure delay`,
       round(100 * count_if(DepDel15 = 1) / count(*), 1) AS `% departing 15+ min late`
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Departure delay by day of week

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DayOfWeek AS dow,
       element_at(array('Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'), DayOfWeek) AS day,
       round(avg(DepDelay), 1) AS `Avg departure delay`,
       round(100 * count_if(DepDel15 = 1) / count(*), 1) AS `% departing 15+ min late`
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
GROUP BY DayOfWeek ORDER BY DayOfWeek

panels.title: Average departure delay by airport
panels.description: Colour = mean departure delay (minutes). Airports with 100+ departures; hover for details.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.airport AS airport, any_value(a.airport_name) AS name, any_value(a.lat) AS lat, any_value(a.lon) AS lon,
       CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) AS flights, round(avg(o.DepDelay), 1) AS avg_dep_delay
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime AS o
INNER JOIN ${catalog}.faa.airport_station AS a ON a.airport = o.Origin
WHERE o.FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND o.Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND o.Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
GROUP BY a.airport HAVING count(*) >= 100

panels.title: Most delayed airports
panels.description: Airports with 1,000+ departures in range, worst first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Origin AS Airport, any_value(OriginCityName) AS City, count(*) AS Departures,
       round(try_divide(100 * count_if(DepDel15 = 1), count_if(Cancelled = 0)), 1) AS `Late departures %`,
       round(avg(DepDelay), 1) AS `Avg dep delay`,
       round(100 * avg(Cancelled), 2) AS `Cancelled %`
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
GROUP BY Origin HAVING count(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY `Late departures %` DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Top 10 least reliable city pairs
panels.description: Airport pairs, both directions together, with the most carrier cancellations (code A) per 1,000 flights, among pairs with at least the minimum number of completed flights; ties go to the pair with more carrier delay per flight. The Origin airport filter applies to where each flight left from.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT `City pair`, `Carrier cxl / 1k flights`, delay,
       -- city names from one flight of the pair, ordered like the airport codes
       if(one_flight.Origin < one_flight.Dest, concat(one_flight.OriginCityName, ' – ', one_flight.DestCityName),
          concat(one_flight.DestCityName, ' – ', one_flight.OriginCityName)) AS Cities,
       -- as text, so they appear in the tooltip without being drawn as bars
       CAST(flights AS STRING) AS Flights, CAST(delay AS STRING) AS `Carrier delay min/flt`
FROM (
    SELECT concat(least(Origin, Dest), '–', greatest(Origin, Dest)) AS `City pair`,
           round(try_divide(1000 * count_if(Cancelled = 1 AND CancellationCode = 'A'), count(*)), 1) AS `Carrier cxl / 1k flights`,
           round(try_divide(sum(CarrierDelay), count_if(Cancelled = 0)), 1) AS delay,
           any_value(struct(Origin, Dest, OriginCityName, DestCityName)) AS one_flight,
           count(*) AS flights
    FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
    GROUP BY 1 HAVING count_if(Cancelled = 0) >= ${min_flights}
    ORDER BY `Carrier cxl / 1k flights` DESC, delay DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
ORDER BY `Carrier cxl / 1k flights` DESC, delay DESC

panels.title: Top 10 least reliable flight numbers
panels.description: Flight numbers with the most carrier cancellations (code A) per 1,000 flights, among those with at least the minimum number of completed flights; ties go to the one with more carrier delay per flight. Airlines reuse a number on several routes over time: the label shows the route it flew most, and the tooltip how many it flew.

targets.rawSql:
-- Rank first, then find the main route of just the ten flights ranked.
WITH top AS (
    SELECT Reporting_Airline AS airline, Flight_Number_Reporting_Airline AS number, count(*) AS n_flights,
           round(try_divide(1000 * count_if(Cancelled = 1 AND CancellationCode = 'A'), count(*)), 1) AS cxl,
           round(try_divide(sum(CarrierDelay), count_if(Cancelled = 0)), 1) AS carrier_delay
    FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
    GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count_if(Cancelled = 0) >= ${min_flights}
    ORDER BY cxl DESC, carrier_delay DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT concat(airline, ' ', CAST(number AS STRING), ' (', mode(concat(Origin, '–', Dest)), ')') AS Flight,
       any_value(cxl) AS `Carrier cxl / 1k flights`, any_value(carrier_delay) AS delay,
       -- as text, so they appear in the tooltip without being drawn as bars
       CAST(count(DISTINCT Origin, Dest) AS STRING) AS Routes,
       CAST(any_value(n_flights) AS STRING) AS Flights, CAST(any_value(carrier_delay) AS STRING) AS `Carrier delay min/flt`
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime INNER JOIN top ON Reporting_Airline = airline AND Flight_Number_Reporting_Airline = number
WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND Origin IN (${origin:singlequote})
GROUP BY airline, number
ORDER BY `Carrier cxl / 1k flights` DESC, delay DESC
